177:t_1:89.en:
$$アムロ$$
「There are people who help us, like Lieutenant $$マネキン$$ and him.」

177:t_1:91.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I'm Major $$グラハム・エーカー$$. I'll be relying on you again.」

177:t_1:92.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's been a while, Major $$グラハム$$.」

177:t_1:93.en:
$$さやか$$
「Have you still not had a proper talk with $$刹那$$?」

177:t_1:94.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I still can't forgive myself...」

177:t_1:95.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then, during our attack on North America's $$セントラル・ベース$$, we lost to the $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$, $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$, and had to retreat.」

177:t_1:96.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$バルビエル$$... So he got in your way on $$蒼の地球$$, too...」

177:t_1:97.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Without support from $$ゼロ$$ and the others, we might have fallen victim to his poison, too...」

177:t_1:98.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$カレン$$... Were you fighting in $$新日本$$ the whole time?」

177:t_1:99.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$ゼロ$$, $$スザク$$, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$, and I joined the $$新日本$$ Volunteer Army alongside former $$黒の騎士団$$ members.」

177:t_1:100.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That's $$新日本$$ for you, a nation of resistance fighters. A volunteer army's pretty impressive.」

177:t_1:101.en:
$$デュオ$$
「The $$プリベンター$$s and those of us working with them joined, too.」

177:t_1:102.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm relieved you were there too, $$五飛$$.」

177:t_1:103.en:
$$五飛$$
「I won't waver anymore. I intend to devote my life to the fight to restore peace.」

177:t_1:104.en:
$$カトル$$
「Besides us, other forces $$ゼロ$$ had gathered were assembling in $$新日本$$.」

177:t_1:105.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$竜馬$$... I never thought you'd be in $$新日本$$, too.」

177:t_1:106.en:
$$竜馬$$
「When I heard about a small force crushing a huge army, I couldn't sit still.」

177:t_1:107.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But $$竜馬$$, $$大貫$$ was worried when you suddenly quit being $$陣代高校$$'s janitor.」

177:t_1:108.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Apologize to him for me. Tell him I'll be counting on him again once things settle down.」

177:t_1:109.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「And then there's $$ロジャー・スミス$$ and $$キリコ・キュービィー$$.」

177:t_1:110.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I fought in $$新日本$$ during the $$再世戦争$$, too.」

177:t_1:111.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Since words cannot reach the likes of $$サイデリアル$$, I reluctantly had no choice but to accept $$ゼロ$$'s invitation.」

177:t_1:113.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$キリコ$$ hasn't changed either, it seems.」

177:t_1:114.en:
$$カレン$$
($$キリコ$$... You fought to protect $$新日本$$, the place of your memories with $$フィアナ$$...)

177:t_1:115.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「But in the end... the $$黒の騎士団$$ lost, and we were driven out of $$新日本$$.」

177:t_1:116.en:
$$スザク$$
「We lost because of $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$'s attack...」

177:t_1:117.en:
$$宗介$$
「So it was him here, too...」

177:t_1:118.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Like 《$$ガドライト#keyword$$》, that man can use his $$スフィア$$ to manipulate people's minds...」

177:t_1:120.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「He amplifies the hatred in people's hearts.」

177:t_1:121.en:
$$ノイン$$
「That turned $$新日本$$'s citizens into rioters... Their suppressed hatred of $$ゼロ$$ took control of them...」

177:t_1:122.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And I... used the $$ギアス$$ I'd vowed never to use again, to stop them...」

177:t_1:124.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「No... If my failure to stop $$バルビエル$$ caused it, I cannot forgive myself...」

177:t_1:126.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I know. $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$ forced me to use $$ギアス$$ and plunged $$新日本$$ into war again...」

177:t_1:128.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「What's happening in $$新日本$$ now?」

177:t_1:129.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「General $$藤堂$$ and the former $$黒の騎士団$$ members are continuing their guerrilla resistance.」

177:t_1:130.en:
$$デュオ$$
「They've got guts. However overwhelming $$サイデリアル$$ is, it'll take a long time to silence them completely.」

177:t_1:131.en:
$$トロワ$$
「We left the fight in $$新日本$$ to them, then crossed to North America and joined $$カミーユ$$'s group.」

177:t_1:132.en:
$$甲児$$
「Were you in $$オーブ$$, $$キラ$$? Is that where you joined $$カミーユ$$'s group?」

177:t_1:133.en:
$$キラ$$
「Yes... Until then, I was guarding $$オードリー$$ and Vice Foreign Minister $$リリーナ$$ with Ensign $$リディ$$.」

177:t_1:134.en:
$$さやか$$
「$$オードリー$$ was in $$オーブ$$ too...!?」

177:t_1:135.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Yes... Ensign $$リディ$$'s family, the $$マーセナス家$$, arranged it.」

177:t_1:136.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Though they were about to hand $$オードリー$$ over to $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス$$ as a bargaining chip...」

177:t_1:137.en:
$$ボス$$
「$$アナハイム$$ is that huge corporation on the Moon, right? Why would they...?」

177:t_1:138.en:
$$バナージ$$
「One of its executives, $$マーサ・ビスト・カーバイン$$, is working to seal away $$ラプラスの箱$$.」

177:t_1:139.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The executive joined forces with the $$マーセナス家$$, who share that objective.」

177:t_1:141.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$ said... it was a prayer offered in the past that had turned into a curse.」

177:t_1:143.en:
$$甲児$$
「Hold on...! Then Ensign $$リディ$$ knows what's in the Box!?」

177:t_1:148.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'll take over the story from $$オーブ$$ onward.」

177:t_1:149.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ appeared in $$オーブ$$ and demanded the surrender of Vice Foreign Ministers $$リリーナ$$ and $$ナナリー$$, Princess $$マリナ$$, and Representative $$アスハ$$.」

177:t_1:150.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$カガリ$$ and the others accepted that demand so we could escape.」

177:t_1:152.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$オーブ$$ fell. Representative $$アスハ$$ and the others were probably captured by the Empire.」

177:t_1:153.en:
$$キラ$$
「Then $$バナージ$$ and Ensign $$リディ$$ went up into space separately from us to get $$ミネバ・ザビ$$ to safety.」

177:t_1:154.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「They were picked up by the $$ラー・カイラム$$ and Colonel $$シャア$$'s group aboard it.」

177:t_1:155.en:
$$甲児$$
「What had the Colonel been doing until then?」

177:t_1:156.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「He's been visiting the colonies, gathering forces opposed to $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

177:t_1:157.en:
$$クェス$$
「I was helping with that, too.」

177:t_1:158.en:
$$甲児$$
「Major $$コンロイ$$...! And $$クェス$$, too...!」

177:t_1:159.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Let me introduce a pilot assigned to the $$ラー・カイラム$$.」

177:t_1:160.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「I'm Captain $$ナイジェル・ギャレット$$. I'm counting on your cooperation.」

177:t_1:161.en:
$$宗介$$
「Are you from the $$トライスター$$...?」

177:t_1:162.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「It seems I'm somewhat well known.」

177:t_1:164.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's $$ロンド・ベル$$'s ace pilot unit. Those in the know say they're extremely skilled.」

177:t_1:165.en:
$$宗介$$
「Captain $$ナイジェル$$... I heard the $$トライスター$$ has three members, as its name suggests...」

177:t_1:166.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「My comrades $$ダリル$$ and $$ワッツ$$ are on close escort duty for the $$ラー・カイラム$$. Only I will fight on the front lines.」

177:t_1:167.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then $$バナージ$$'s group was attacked by $$マリーダ$$ aboard the $$ラー・カイラム$$...」

177:t_1:168.en:
$$甲児$$
「Had she gone back to $$ネオ・ジオン$$?」
